services.desc: You and your elite team of soldiers have been dropped into a top secret Department of Defense facility where zombies are being used to test experimental weapons. After a particularly “bitey” incident someone blew the whistle and the place must be swept clean before the project is made public. Your mission is to eliminate all the zombies before the air force carpet bombs the entire facility with you in it. Note: 2 person minimum. You will have the entire room for just your party. If you have additional participants they can pay on arrival (10 total maximum). No need to notify us of additional participants ahead of time.
